analyzer: Next.js 16.3.6 experimental-analyze; data from .next/diagnostics/analyze/data/[locale]/analyze.data and modules.data
size_semantics: raw is emitted module/chunk source bytes; compressed is Next analyzer compressed_size (gzip-oriented compressed estimate). It is not a browser network capture. Brotli not recorded.

request_trigger_evidence.custom_jsx: widgetModuleLoaders -> custom-api/index.ts async componentLoader -> custom-api/component.tsx async CustomJsxDisplay -> custom-jsx-display.tsx -> custom-jsx-renderer.tsx -> runtime-components.tsx and component-registry.ts -> generated catalog
request_trigger_evidence.weather: widgetComponentLoaders weather entry async imports weather/component.tsx; weather/component.tsx statically imports AdvancedWeather, so compact mode still requests the same emitted weather component chunk.

gaps: No browser cold-cache request trace or request delay measurement.

No direct per-route initial-vs-lazy client transfer projection was extracted from the analyzer GUI; the production module graph and async edges establish the deferral boundaries, while chunk totals above are measured for the emitted chunks.
No browser heap or RAM profile.
